name: Pócspetri (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pócspetri (a crowned light blue shield with a yellow bow and arrow, a crescent and stars, within a yellow frame) above the name PÓCSPETRI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pócspetri arms with crown and frame
